notes.title: CG Gallery + exciting future updates
notes.content: [h2]CG gallery[/h2][p]Heart of Summer now has a CG gallery which you can access from the main menu when you start the game.  In "Memories" you can collect all your most memorable summer moments![/p][p]Unfortunately, implementing this post-launch means that if you have played a certain route previously, you have to replay each CG specific scene after the update to unlock the related images. Please note that certain CGs may not unlock before you have seen the different versions of it.[/p][p]We apologize for the inconvenience this causes to players, but maybe you'll find some small CG you missed along the way.[/p][h3]Japanese translation?[/h3][p]On a side note concerning the Japanese translation, due to quality assurance, progress has been slower than expected, but is currently underway. We can't give a date yet, but players may expect it SOON.[/p][h3]Future content[/h3][p]In addition to other minor visual tweaks, Heart of Summer is now at its best state since its launch. And the good news is that we are nowhere close to being done with Heart of Summer. In fact, [u]we have new gaming content updates coming[/u] which are much bigger and more exciting than the CG gallery (as essential as that is). We'll keep you updated on that as we inch closer to releasing them.[/p][p]I want to thank all players thus far for playing Heart of Summer.[/p][p]The summer isn't over yet. While we go forward to bring you more content, we'd love to hear from you what you think about the game. Like, you know... what girl you like or something.[/p][p]See you at school![/p][p][i]Ake[/i][/p][p][/p][p]P.S. Takao wants to go to the game center again[/p]
